```artifact
@startuml
sequenceDiagram
    participant Controller
    participant GUI
    participant HardwarePCB

    Controller->>GUI: Alarm detected
    activate GUI
    GUI->>Controller: Alarm code and priority
    deactivate GUI

    Controller->>HardwarePCB: Buzzer command
    activate HardwarePCB
    HardwarePCB->>Controller: Buzzer status
    deactivate HardwarePCB

    GUI->>Controller: List of active alarms
    activate Controller
    Controller->>GUI: List of alarms
    deactivate GUI

    GUI->>Controller: Alarm on main screen
    activate Controller
    Controller->>GUI: Alarm display
    deactivate GUI

    GUI->>Controller: Legibility check
    activate Controller
    Controller->>GUI: Legibility status
    deactivate GUI

    alt High severity alarm
        GUI->>Controller: Alarm color and flashing frequency
        activate Controller
        Controller->>HardwarePCB: Buzzer configuration
        deactivate HardwarePCB
    else Low severity alarm
        GUI->>Controller: Alarm color
        activate Controller
        Controller->>HardwarePCB: Buzzer configuration
        deactivate HardwarePCB
    end
@enduml
```
